title: Preserve section controls when replacing paragraph runs
when: A serializer clears the initial paragraph or rebuilds section content.
do: Preserve secPr and section ctrl; set intentional header/footer heights.
Do not let table anchor paragraphs add unintended page height.
check: Native page count and actual question starts, not only declared page metadata.
limitation: The base Daechi serializer already contains the corrective preservation logic.
